scripts.test: node scripts/with-env.mjs --unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL,ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN,ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS,NARRATION_MODEL,OPENROUTER_API_KEY,OPENROUTER_BASE_URL sh -c 'node --test scripts/env-file.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/fight-club test'
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
